platform: MyClassCampus: historical cloud-based, web and mobile education ERP; standalone product status is currently unclear after Teachmint acquisition.

distinctive_features.feature: Broad historical ERP spanning academics, finance, HR and campus operations.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Institutions could manage many administrative and operational workflows in one platform.
Groups could configure access and oversee multiple institutional branches.

distinctive_features.feature: GPS transport management with routes, waypoints, dashboards and reports.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Schools could track vehicles and manage transport operations through the ERP.
Institutions could connect biometric devices to attendance workflows.

distinctive_features.feature: Pocket Study integrated LMS with study materials, quizzes and online classes.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Learners and teachers could access teaching and learning tools alongside ERP services.

distinctive_features.feature: Dynamic certificate generation with field logic.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Administrative staff could produce certificates using configurable fields.

distinctive_features.feature: DIY website builder and hosting service.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Institutions could manage a website as part of the platform offering.

distinctive_features.feature: QR profile scanning and student wallet.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: These tools offered identity and payment convenience in the historical module set.

weaknesses.issue: The legacy ERP's current sales, product status and relationship to Teachmint are not publicly clear.
No current MyClassCampus price, standalone product catalogue or public documentation portal was verified.
The historical iOS app was removed in 2024, and the preserved Android package was last updated in 2023.
No MyClassCampus-specific security certification, hosting region or compliance statement was verified.
No public API support is documented; a third-party product listing says API support is unavailable.
Public review evidence is stale or sparse, limiting confidence about current product quality.

pricing_model_summary: No current official pricing verified. A 2021 report cited ₹100–₹150 per student annually; third-party listings describe quote-based plans.
biggest_strategic_gap: Product continuity and support are unclear: the legacy site redirects, current pricing and documentation are absent, and historical mobile-app evidence is stale.
